rationale: Builds on the recurrent-tail baseline with a compact validation-aligned loss curriculum: training progressively downweights prefix tokens and keeps full weight on the suffix window that most closely matches final stride-based scoring. The edit stays compile-stable by using a fixed-shape mask input, preserves the existing reverse-tail/quant-aware endgame, and reuses chunked microbatch handling so large microbatches still fit MLX constraints.
title: Late Tail-Aligned Training Mask
